title: 第4章 搜他们的身，抢他们的钱！
content_zh:
“尼玛，揍死他！”在豹哥的带领下，几名小混混嗷嗷怪叫着，一窝蜂的向叶寒两人冲来，大有一往无前、悍不畏死之势。

看到豹哥等人大嚷大叫的冲过来，叶壮吓的筋酸腿软，哀叹一声，蹲下身子，双臂抱住脑袋埋到胸口里，准备迎接他们的围攻。

“麻痹的，这帮小混混太嚣张了！”

看到自己一脚踹飞那个小混混，非但没能震慑住豹哥等人，反而惹得他们群起而攻，叶寒冷哼一声，身形不退反进，大步迎上前去，如猛虎闯入羊群，拳脚并用，眨眼间的功夫，就把几个气势汹汹的混混打倒在地。

“我地妈呀！”叶壮呆了半天，才从震惊中回过神来，看着地上鼻青脸肿、哭爹喊娘的豹哥等人，他狠狠掐了一下自己，才知道这不是在做梦。

以前的叶寒，是个战力值只有五的渣，就连班里的女生都可以任意欺负他，可现在他三拳两脚就把豹哥等人打的屁滚尿流，这简直太令人匪夷所思，也难怪叶壮有种不太真实的感觉。

豹哥等人不是好东西，叶寒也不是什么正人君子，冲着一旁还有些发呆的叶壮呶了呶嘴，“嘿嘿”笑道：“这帮浑蛋经常在学校附近向学生要‘保护费’，身上一定有不少钱！反正都是些不义之财，与其留给他们作孽，不如救济咱们两个穷人！叶壮，过去搜他们的身，抢他们的钱！”

“好勒！”见豹哥等人已经没了反抗之力，再想想叶寒突如其来的一身本事，叶壮顿时觉得什么也不怕了，兴奋的搓了搓手，走到豹哥等人身边，在他们身上仔细搜了一遍，果然搜出一百多块钱来。

“这些钱你留着花！”见叶壮要把搜来的钱交给自己，叶寒摆了摆手，笑着道：“以前你替我垫过不少‘保护费’，我都记得呢！”

叶壮也不客气，把钱塞进了自己衣兜里，道：“那行，这钱放我这里，咱们共用！”

“嗯，咱们走！”叶寒转身向胡同外走去，看也不看地上的豹哥等人，对他来说，这几个无良小混混，无异于几只蝼蚁，根本不值一哂。

叶壮屁颠屁颠跟随在叶寒身后，这一刻，他只觉得叶寒原本略显削瘦的背影变的无比高大起来。

“叶寒，你怎么突然间变的那么能打了？”

“哦，前些阵子在放学的路上，我遇到了一个老乞丐，那老乞丐说我天资聪颖，骨骼清奇，是百年难得一见的练武奇才，以后维护世界和平的任务就交给我了，于是送了我一本武林秘籍。嘿嘿，我照着练了一段时间，就成这样了。”

“不用这种眼光看着我，我说的是真的，不然你认为我怎么会这么能打？”

“日啊，那老乞丐送你的秘籍呢？给我也练练，我也想维护世界和平！”

“秘籍我看过后烧掉了……不过你想学的话，以后我可以教你。”

叶壮和叶寒的家，都位于城市郊区，之间相隔有两百多米的距离，两人在一个十字路口分手后，叶寒循着记忆中的路径，缓步而行，片刻后就摸到了自己在这个世界里的家中。

这是一个面积不大的院落，院子里的地面，是用青砖铺成的，坑坑洼洼的已经不太平整。

院子北侧是三间看起来非常破旧的砖瓦房，西侧靠墙的地方圈养着一些鸡鸭，东侧是厨房和杂物房，南侧栽种着一株石榴树，石榴树下放置着一辆破旧的小推车，另外院子里还开辟出了两小块菜地，菜地里种着些时下常吃的蔬菜。

推开院落的大门，叶寒第一眼看到的就是这种景象，家虽破旧，但对于前世是个孤儿、后来被师父带入山中、不知寒暑潜心修炼的叶寒来说，这个小而破旧的院落，却充满了一种家庭的温馨感觉。

叶寒刚刚迈步走进院中，就看到一对穿的脏兮兮的中年男女架着一个燃气罐，吃力的从厨房里向外面的小推车上抬，小推车上已经堆上了小餐桌、小板凳和一些碗筷等等东西。

厨房里，一对少年男女正在帮着收拾东西。

一瞬间，大量的有关这个家庭的讯息，在叶寒脑中迅速涌现出来，他知道，眼前的这对中年男女就是自己在这个世界里的父母，而厨房里的那对少年男女，是自己的哥哥和妹妹。

父亲叶奎，母亲杨秀英，以前在同一个厂子里上班，后来企业改制，两人双双下岗，靠着一份微薄的政府救济金度日，后来为了供养哥哥妹妹以及自己读书，两口子商量着购置了一辆小推车和餐具，每天到附近的一个人流量较大的广场上出摊卖点小吃，赚些小钱。

哥哥叶山，妹妹叶婷，和自己一样都在市一中读书，一个高三，一个初一，他们的学习成绩虽然都不算拔尖，但比起自己这个学混子来，却是强了不知多少倍。

父母做的是小本生意，赚的钱并不多，但两口子每天依然要从傍晚忙到深夜，然后第二天还要给自己兄妹三人做饭，哥哥妹妹倒还罢了，知道孝顺父母，尊敬长辈，而自己……不，应该是自己的前身，却对他们的辛苦付出视而不见，十足的一个不孝子……

我已经占据了他们儿子的身体，那么今后这个家，也就是我的家了，这个家里的亲人，也就是我的亲人了，那么好吧，从现在开始，我就要尽到一个家庭成员应有的责任。

叶寒这样想着，立即绾起衣袖，大步走上前去，从母亲杨秀英的手里接过燃气罐，轻声道：“妈，让我来！”

“叶寒，放学啦？”杨秀英看了一眼儿子，似乎没想到他会主动过来帮忙，一时间有些怔神，随即道：“不用你帮忙！饭已经做好了，在锅里热着呢，你和叶山、叶婷一起去吃吧！这里有我和你爸忙着就行！”

叶寒有些霸道的把母亲挤开，帮着父亲将燃气罐一起架到小推车上，叶奎累的气喘吁吁、额头冒汗，他却没事儿一般。

“哥！小婷！”叶寒冲着叶山和叶婷笑了笑，打了声招呼，然后继续帮着父母整理东西。

杨秀英垂手站在一旁，默默看着自己这个二子，总觉得他今天似乎有些不太对劲儿，但又说不上来究竟哪里不对，看着二子殷勤的帮着丈夫向小推车上拾掇一些杂物，心里不由感慨万千，在她的记忆里，这可是二子多年来第一次主动帮着父母干活。

叶奎是个寡言少语、只知道闷头做事的老实人，但这并不代表他的心里没有想法，他和妻子一样，也对二子的今天的举止感到非常诧异。

秋天的傍晚，天已经有些凉了，一阵晚风吹过，杨秀英机灵灵的打了个哆嗦，见三个儿女还在忙着，心疼的道：“叶儿、叶寒、叶婷，不用你们收拾了，快进屋去吃饭吧！吃完了碗筷就放在院子里的水池中，等妈回来再刷洗！”

叶寒把最后一个小凳子塞进小推车里，这才接过母亲递来的湿毛巾擦了擦手，笑着道：“妈，我们干这点活算什么，真正累的是你们啊！”

杨秀英和叶奎听到他这句话，互视一眼，只觉心底深处的某个柔软区域被触动了，鼻尖都有些酸酸的。
content_en:
"Fuck him, beat him to death!" Under the leadership of Brother Bao, several gangsters screamed and rushed towards Ye Han and the two of them in a swarm, showing a strong tendency to move forward and not be afraid of death.

Seeing Brother Bao and others rushing over with shouts, Ye Zhuang was so frightened that his muscles and legs were weak. He sighed, squatted down, hugged his head with his arms and buried it in his chest, preparing to face their siege.

"Damn it, these gangsters are so arrogant!"

Seeing that he had kicked the little gangster away, instead of intimidating Brother Bao and the others, it actually caused them to attack in groups. Ye Hanhan snorted and stepped forward without retreating. He strode forward like a tiger breaking into a herd of sheep. He used his fists and feet at the same time and knocked down several aggressive gangsters to the ground in the blink of an eye.

"Holy shit!" Ye Zhuang stayed for a long time before he recovered from the shock. He looked at Brother Bao and others with bruises and swollen faces on the ground, crying for their fathers and mothers. He pinched himself hard and realized that this was not a dream.

In the past, Ye Han was a scumbag with a combat power value of only five, and even the girls in the class could bully him at will. But now he beat the shit out of Brother Bao and others with three punches and two kicks. This is simply unbelievable. No wonder Ye Zhuang feels unreal.

Brother Bao and others are not good people, and Ye Han is not a gentleman either. He babbled at Ye Zhuang, who was still in a daze, and said with a smile: "These bastards often ask for 'protection money' from students near the school. They must have a lot of money! They are all ill-gotten gains anyway. Instead of leaving them to do evil, why not help us two poor people! Ye Zhuang, go over and search their bodies and rob their money!"

"Okay!" Seeing that Brother Bao and others had no strength to resist, and thinking about Ye Han's sudden ability, Ye Zhuang suddenly felt that he was not afraid of anything anymore. He rubbed his hands excitedly, walked to Brother Bao and others, and searched them carefully, and sure enough, more than one hundred yuan was found.

"Keep the money for yourself!" Seeing that Ye Zhuang was about to hand over the collected money to him, Ye Han waved his hand and said with a smile: "You have paid me a lot of 'protection money' in the past, I still remember it!"

Ye Zhuang was not polite. He stuffed the money into his pocket and said, "Okay, leave the money here and we can share it!"

"Well, let's go!" Ye Han turned around and walked out of the alley without looking at Brother Bao and others on the ground. To him, these unscrupulous gangsters were nothing more than a few ants and not worth a damn.

Ye Zhuangpianpidian followed Ye Han. At this moment, he felt that Ye Han's originally thin back had become extremely tall.

"Ye Han, why did you suddenly become so good at fighting?"

"Oh, a while ago, I met an old beggar on the way out of school. The old beggar said that I was talented and had a wonderful skeleton. I was a rare martial arts wizard in a hundred years. From now on, I would be tasked with maintaining world peace, so he gave me a martial arts secret book. Hehe, I practiced according to it for a while, and it became like this."

"Don't look at me like that. What I said is true. Otherwise, why do you think I can fight so well?"

"Hey, where is the secret book that the old beggar gave you? Give it to me and practice it, I also want to maintain world peace!"

"I burned the secret book after reading it...but if you want to learn it, I can teach you in the future."

The homes of Ye Zhuang and Ye Han were both located in the suburbs of the city, more than 200 meters apart. After the two separated at a crossroads, Ye Han walked slowly along the path in his memory, and after a while he felt his home in this world.

This is a small courtyard. The ground in the courtyard is paved with blue bricks, and the pits are uneven.

On the north side of the yard are three very dilapidated-looking brick houses. On the west side are some chickens and ducks raised against the wall. On the east side are the kitchen and utility room. On the south side is a pomegranate tree. Under the pomegranate tree is a dilapidated cart. In addition, two small vegetable plots have been opened in the yard, and some commonly eaten vegetables are grown in the vegetable plots.

This was the first thing Ye Han saw when he opened the door of the courtyard. Although his home was dilapidated, for Ye Han, who was an orphan in his previous life and was later taken into the mountains by his master and devoted himself to cultivation regardless of the cold or heat, this small and dilapidated courtyard was filled with a warm feeling of family.

As soon as Ye Han stepped into the courtyard, he saw a pair of dirty middle-aged men and women holding a gas tank and struggling to lift it from the kitchen to a trolley outside. The trolley was already piled with a small dining table, a small bench, some bowls and chopsticks and other items.

In the kitchen, a young man and woman were helping to pack things.

In an instant, a large amount of information about this family quickly emerged in Ye Han's mind. He knew that the middle-aged man and woman in front of him were his parents in this world, and the young man and woman in the kitchen were his brother and sister.

Father Ye Kui and mother Yang Xiuying used to work in the same factory. Later, the company was reorganized and they were both laid off. They lived on a meager government relief fund. Later, in order to support their brothers and sisters and to study by themselves, the couple discussed buying a small cart and tableware. Every day, they went to a nearby square with a large flow of people to sell snacks and earn some money.

My brother Ye Shan and my sister Ye Ting are both studying in No. 1 Middle School like me. One is a senior in high school and the other is a freshman in junior high school. Although their academic performance is not top-notch, they are many times better than me, a bastard in school.

My parents run a small business and don't make much money, but the couple still have to work from dusk to late at night every day, and then have to cook for their three brothers and sisters the next day. The brother and sister just pay it forward. They know how to be filial to their parents and respect their elders, but I... no, it should be my predecessor, but I turn a blind eye to their hard work. I am completely an unfilial son...

I have taken over their son's body, so from now on, this home will be my home, and the relatives in this family will be my relatives. Well, from now on, I will fulfill the responsibilities of a family member.

Ye Han thought like this, immediately rolled up his sleeves, strode forward, took the gas tank from his mother Yang Xiuying's hand, and said softly: "Mom, let me do it!"

"Ye Han, school is over?" Yang Xiuying glanced at her son, as if she didn't expect that he would take the initiative to help. She was a little dazed for a moment, and then said: "You don't need your help! The rice is already done and is heating in the pot. You can go eat with Ye Shan and Ye Ting! Your dad and I will be busy here!"

Ye Han pushed his mother away somewhat domineeringly and helped his father put the gas tanks on the trolley. Ye Kuilei was panting and sweating on his forehead, but he seemed fine.

"Brother! Xiaoting!" Ye Han smiled at Ye Shan and Ye Ting, said hello, and then continued to help his parents pack things.

Yang Xiuying stood aside with her hands down, silently looking at her second son. She always felt that something was wrong with him today, but she couldn't tell what was wrong. Seeing her second son diligently helping her husband pack some sundries on the trolley, she couldn't help but feel filled with emotion. In her memory, this was the first time in many years that her second son took the initiative to help her parents with work.

Ye Kui is an honest man who talks little and only knows how to do things, but this does not mean that he has no thoughts in his heart. Like his wife, he is also very surprised by the second son's behavior today.

In the autumn evening, the sky was already a little cold. A gust of evening wind blew by. Yang Xiuying shivered cleverly. Seeing her three children still busy, she said distressedly: "Ye'er, Ye Han, and Ye Ting, you don't have to clean up anymore. Come in and eat! After you finish eating, put the bowls and chopsticks in the pool in the yard, and wash them again when mom comes back!"

Ye Han stuffed the last small stool into the trolley, then took the wet towel from his mother and wiped his hands, and said with a smile: "Mom, it doesn't matter if we do this little work, you are the ones who are really tired!"

When Yang Xiuying and Ye Kui heard his words, they looked at each other and felt that a soft area deep in their hearts had been touched, and the tips of their noses felt a little sour.
